teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions covering functions, variables, and conditionals, and answered student questions during office hours.
Graded programming exercises using an instructor-provided rubric as part of assigned introductory programming teaching assistant activities.

projects.title: Text-File Analyser
bullets: Implemented a small command-line text-file analyser in Python using functions and collections for an individual undergraduate course project.
Tested example inputs and documented the program's behaviour, using Git for the course project.
